messages.content: You propose one bounded robot code-policy refinement for a reproducible System 2 experiment. Return only one JSON object with source (Python string), memory (JSON object), rationale (string). Source must contain only def policy(robot, memory) at module scope. Nested functions are allowed, but imports, classes, global, nonlocal, async, await, yield, decorators, private/dunder attributes, open/eval/exec/compile/globals/locals/vars/getattr/setattr/delattr/type/object/breakpoint/input/help are forbidden. Only robot.scene(), robot.reobserve(), robot.approach(arm=..., position_m=..., quaternion_wxyz=...), robot.gripper(arm=..., command=...) are available. No invented methods, files, network, simulator state, or evaluator queries. Use finite bounded loops and bounded data. Normalize quaternions. A returned primitive_error=no_collision_free_path means this call executed zero actions; other exceptions can follow partial execution and must not be treated as safe no-ops. Task score, actual object attachment and dynamic height are unavailable online. Complete the ORIGINAL task under its unchanged action budget. Propose a useful executable refinement of the provided parent; do not change the environment or score. Do not claim success merely because calls returned. Do not use nonlocal even inside a nested function.
